ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $ \angle AOB=30^\circ$, $ \angle AOE=140^\circ$, $OB$ bisects $ \angle AOC$, and $OD$ bisects $ \angle AOE$. Find the degree measure of $ \angle COD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}

Since $\angle AOE = 140^\circ$ and $\angle AOC = 60^\circ$,

it follows that $\angle COE = \angle AOE - \angle AOC = 140^\circ - 60^\circ = 80^\circ$.

Also, since OD bisects $\angle AOE$,

we have $\angle DOE = \frac{1}{2} \angle AOE = \frac{1}{2} \times 140^\circ = 70^\circ$.

Therefore, $\angle COD = \angle COE - \angle DOE = 80^\circ - 70^\circ = \boxed{10^\circ}$.

Reasoning: According to the specified method, take OA as the 0° direction. It is known that ∠AOB = 30°, so OB is in the 30° direction.
